title: Which path to the river is shortest?
description: A water carrier walks from a house to a river bank and then to a water tank. The video treats the river bank as a mirror, reflects the tank, and joins the house to the reflection with a straight line. Where that line meets the bank is the best place to fill water.
teaching_notes: One idea: reflect the tank in the river bank, so the bent walk becomes a straight line. Watch for students who fill water at the spot on the bank nearest to the house.

video_script.why: The child applies the mirror method of the solved example, reflecting one end in the line to turn a bent walk into a straight one.
video_script.substitution: Reflect the water tank in the river bank, then join the house to the reflection with a straight line.
video_script.anchor: the book's map: a house, a river bank above it and a water tank, with the water carrier's walk from the house to the bank and on to the tank
video_script.payoff_line: The best spot is where the straight line meets the river bank

final_answer.value: Reflect the tank in the river bank; the straight line from the house to the reflection meets the bank at the best point
final_answer.spoken: the best spot is where the straight line meets the river bank

hold_back: Reflect the tank in the river bank; the straight line from the house to the reflection meets the bank at the best point
never_show: the answer before the answer beat
maths_rules: the river bank is a line l; the house H and the tank T are on the same side of it
reflect T in l to get T'; for every point P on l, PT = PT'
so HP + PT = HP + PT', which is the length of a path from H to T' that bends at P
the shortest path from H to T' is the straight line HT', so the best P is where HT' meets l
any other P on l gives a bent path H to P to T', which is longer than the straight line HT'
the walk is H to P to T, as long as the straight line HT'
video_script.design: One map all video. The river bank is a mirror, the tank is reflected, and the bent walk becomes a straight line. No numbers are given, so the answer is a method.
open_questions: The map has no measurements, so the answer is the method and the place to fill water, not a length.
